lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots of varying diameters are distributed across the mid-lateral flank, with higher density in the area posterior to the head region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to form a grid-like pattern across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges run horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A group of at least five slender commensal fish is visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral flank and the left pectoral fin.
